pv42:1.1: Pubbe katānaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko mathaye manaṃ; rūpe sadde rase gandhe phoṭṭhabbe ca manorame, || ||
pv42:2.1: Naccaṃ gītaṃ ratiṃ khiḍḍaṃ anubhutvā anappakaṃ uyyāne paricaritvā pavisanto Giribbajaṃ, || ||
pv42:3.1: Isiṃ Sunettam addakkhi attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ appicchaṃ hirisampannaṃ uñche pattagate rataṃ. || ||
pv42:4.1: Hatthikkhandhato oruyha laddhā bhante ti c' abravi; tassa pattaṃ gahetvāna uccaṃ paggayha khattiyo, || ||
pv42:5.1: Thaṇḍile pattaṃ bhinditvā hasamāno apakkami, rañño Kitavass' ahaṃ putto kiṃ maṃ bhikkhu karissasi. || ||
pv42:6.1: Tassa kammassa pharusassa vipāko kaṭuko ahu yaṃ rājaputto vedesi nirayamhi samappito. || ||
pv42:7.1: {Chaḷ' eva} caturāsīti vassāni nahutāni ca bhusaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchittho niraye katakibbiso. || ||
pv42:8.1: Uttāno pi ca paccittha nikujjo vāmadakkhiṇo uddhaṃpādo ṭhito c' eva ciraṃ bālo apaccatha. || ||
pv42:9.1: Bahūni vassasahassāni pūgāni nahutāni ca bhusaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchittho niraye katakibbiso. || ||
pv42:10.1: Etādisaṃ kho kaṭukaṃ appaduṭṭhapadosinaṃ paccanti pāpakammantā isim āsajja subbataṃ. || ||
pv42:11.1: So tattha bahudukkhāni vedayitvā bahuṃ dukhaṃ khuppipāsāhato nāma peto āsi tato cuto. || ||
pv42:12.1: Etaṃ ādīnavaṃ disvā issaramadasambhavaṃ pahāya issaramadaṃ nivātam anuvattaye. || ||
pv42:13.1: Diṭṭhe va dhamme pāsaṃso yo buddhesu sagāravo kāyassa bhedā sappañño saggaṃ so upapajjatī ti. || ||
